Fix Cross-Network (Mirpur 1 ↔ Mirpur 12)

🟢 Method 1 — Tailscale (Best, Free, Permanent)

Creates a private encrypted network between your two laptops. Install once, works forever on any internet connection.

  • 1Both laptops: curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh | sh
  • 2Login same account on both: sudo tailscale up
  • 3Office laptop get IP: tailscale ip --4
  • 4Home laptop: python network_tunnel.py --set-worker http://100.X.X.X:8000

🔵 Method 2 — Cloudflare Tunnel (Instant)

Run on office laptop. Creates a public HTTPS URL. No installation required.

  • 1Office laptop: python network_tunnel.py --start-cf
  • 2Copy the URL (e.g. https://xxxx.trycloudflare.com)
  • 3Home laptop: python network_tunnel.py --set-worker <URL>

📱 Phone Access (No LAN Required)

Access from anywhere without being on the same WiFi:

  • 1Home laptop: python mobile/network_tunnel.py --start-cf
  • 2Creates a public URL via cloudflare
  • 3Open the URL on your phone from anywhere
